title: IllegalStateException in CyclesReporter when you have a folder named "workspace"

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
Please provide the following information. The more we know about your system and use case, the more easily and likely we can help.

### Description of the problem / feature request / question:

We have a folder called bazel/workspace with a .bzl file in it and when we try to load this .bzl file we would encounter an IllegalStateException when we do bazel build ...

When the folder is renamed to "verification" the build works.  I think it is due to some changes in cycle detection.  This seems to have started happening in 0.4.1.  


### If possible, provide a minimal example to reproduce the problem:

here's a repo that can be cloned: https://github.com/xynny/bazel-workspace-issue  .  if you run bazel build ... from the root directory it would throw the ISE below. 


### Environment info
* Operating System: mac os x 10.10.5


* Bazel version (output of `bazel info release`):

Xins-MacBook-Pro:bazel-workspace-issue xinlu$ bazel info release
.......
release 0.4.4

###  Have you found anything relevant by searching the web? (e.g. GitHub issues, email threads in the [bazel-discuss@googlegroups.com](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/bazel-discuss) archive)

Seems to be related to recent changes in CyclesReporter, but nothing specific in the forums.
